data.name: ChecklistIntro
data.value: What needs to be done if something happens to you? The checklist guides your trusted persons step by step: first 24 hours, first week, first month, later. Each task shows the matching entries, such as all contracts that should be cancelled. Your trusted persons tick them off together.

data.name: ChecklistShareHint
data.value: For your trusted persons to see the checklist in reading mode, share it with them under “Trusted persons” like any other area. They only see related entries from areas they may see as well.

data.name: ChecklistTemplateText
data.value: {0} tasks from the doctor to the tax office, with deadlines as a guide. They are added to your vault, and you change, add or delete them like any other entry. Not legal advice.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_banks_text
data.value: With the death certificate and a power of attorney or proof of inheritance. Check standing orders; ongoing costs such as rent still need to be paid.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_cancelContracts_text
data.value: These contracts should be cancelled. Many allow special termination on death; enclose the death certificate.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_cancelInsurance_text
data.value: Property insurance such as household or liability often passes to the heirs; check what should remain.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_cards_text
data.value: If lost or misused, block them immediately: in Germany call 116 116.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_deathCertificate_text
data.value: At the registry office of the place of death, usually within three working days; the funeral home often does this. Order several copies: banks, insurers and authorities need them.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_digital_text
data.value: Delete accounts, memorialise or hand them over as wished; reset devices or back up data.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_doctor_text
data.value: If someone dies at home, call the family doctor or the medical on-call service (116 117 in Germany); they issue the death certificate. In a hospital or care home, the staff take care of it. There is no need to rush: taking time to say goodbye is allowed.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_documents_text
data.value: ID card, birth certificate, marriage certificate if applicable, will and powers of attorney. Where the originals are kept is noted with the certificates.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_employer_text
data.value: Employer, personnel number and salary account are listed under income, pension & taxes.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_family_text
data.value: The important contacts list who should be notified. Get support; you do not have to do this alone.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_funeral_text
data.value: Wishes for the service, music, death notice and guests are listed under personal wishes.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_funeral_title
data.value: Plan the memorial service and death notice

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_grave_text
data.value: Arrange the headstone, grave care and the right to use the grave.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_healthInsurance_text
data.value: The health insurer ends the policy; family members who were co-insured may need their own.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_healthInsurance_title
data.value: Inform health and long-term care insurance

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_home_text
data.value: Secure the home, look after pets, dispose of perishable food, collect the mail.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_home_title
data.value: Look after the home, pets and plants

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_inheritance_text
data.value: The deadline to disclaim is usually six weeks from becoming aware. If there are debts or doubts, get advice early, for example from the probate court or a notary. Banks and the land registry often require a certificate of inheritance.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_lifeInsurance_text
data.value: These insurers need to know very quickly, often within 24 to 72 hours, usually 48 hours for accident insurance. A short call or email is enough at first; documents can follow later.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_loans_text
data.value: Inform the creditors; a credit life insurance may pay. With high debts, consider disclaiming the inheritance.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_passwordManager_text
data.value: How to get access is described with the password manager. Many providers have a waiting period for emergency access.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_pension_text
data.value: Apply for a survivor's pension. In Germany, applying for an advance at the pension service within 30 days continues the deceased's pension for three months.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_property_text
data.value: Have the land register corrected, re-register or deregister vehicles, distribute valuables as wished.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_takeOverContracts_text
data.value: These contracts should be taken over, such as electricity, internet or rent.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_taxes_text
data.value: A tax return is usually still needed for the year of death. Report an inheritance to the tax office within three months unless the court or notary already does so.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_undertaker_text
data.value: The funeral home handles the transfer and many formalities, often the death certificate too. Wishes for the funeral and any funeral provision are listed under personal wishes.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_will_text
data.value: Anyone who finds a will must hand it in to the probate court without delay, even if it seems invalid. A deposited will is opened by the court on its own.

data.name: ChecklistTemplate_will_title
data.value: Hand in the will at the probate court

data.name: PackageIntro
data.value: The emergency package has two parts: an HTML file with your datasheets and documents, encrypted, and a key sheet with 24 words to print. Give the file to your family, for example on a USB stick, and keep the sheet in another safe place, such as a safe deposit box or with a notary. Only both together open the package, in any current browser, without a server and without internet.

data.name: PrivacyDefault
data.value:
This myLife instance is run privately for one family. The person who runs it is responsible; the administrator can give you their contact details.
What is stored: your email address, your display name, your language, the times of sign-ins and changes, and a log with shortened IP addresses. The contents of your vault (entries, documents and notes) are encrypted in your browser. Neither the server nor the administrator can read them.
What for: signing in, your trusted persons' emergency access and email notifications. There is no advertising, no analytics and no sharing with third parties; emails only go through the configured mail server.
How long: The log is deleted after the configured period. If your account is deleted, your vault, your documents and your log are gone for good.
Your rights: You can ask for access, correction and deletion at any time. Please contact the administrator of this instance.
